details:
Good morning / Evening / Night Vrchat team. 
Hope the wave of negative feedback regarding planned update of VRchat hasn't been to bad and I personally feel sorry for those who are very toxic about it. 
Before I really start criticize or give some uneducated suggestions. I wanna say you guys made one of the best VR social games and it has been a very big part in my life so far. Met the best friends, even found love once via your games and had absolutely unforgettable experiences. it quickly became my all-time favorite game and I would love to continue playing it.
BUT. here it starts. I have some small and some big problems, that made playing the game, a bit annoying or confusing. which I have been compensating using mods like "compfy menu" "EMM VRC" "portable Mirrors" and so on. 
Now I'm not gonna try pretending to understand how to make a game. 
UI layout 
its confusing and doesn't show a coherent theme. 
Like why are graphics settings under "Security - > advanced security options" instead of just settings. 
Speaking of graphics settings. I am going to just make a comparison to... well pretty much any other game. 
We only get a quality selection and an anti-aliasing setting. what about general "resolutions, textures quality, shadow quality, or player render distance" like settings that you'd find in any other video game but anyway. 
The change of the quick menu to the new launch pad was great I loved that update. but why is this now wierd mix of some features in the launchpad and some features still relying on the old big menu. makes it annoying to use.
Big menu btw. I'd love to have a feature like the mod "compfy menu" provided. cause especially if I was laying down. it's a hassle to use the big menu in its fixed position and rotation. that makes me either sit up or look down wierdly, which is really uncomfortable. 
Full body Calabration mirror. 
something like the modification Protable mirrors provided this feature and it has been a blessing. a game that it supporing up to 11 point tracking should have smth like this in my opinion. Because there aren't mirrors everywhere to help guide the players. 
on the same page. Ever since Ik2.0 and physbomes update. I haven't felt like I had to use IkTweeks since the implementation what great with Ik2.0 really love that update. but one feature I wish that would be implemented as well is the saving of FBT calabration. luckily so far the client EMMVRC as provided that feature but it's something I would really wish to have in the game
Now this point is something a bit out there but a proper Playlist would be really cool. even if it's marked as debug tool. like the mod "Playerlist" provided. I don't know many games that don't provide a informative and easy to read player list. a quick way to identify who is playing in that instance. maybe even showing some additional information about ping (to identify who is crashing for example), in hearing range, who is the master of the room. 
But I know this is quite out there to request . I really understand.
I really can't complain about performance since I know there are big limitations within the unity engine but I'd say an easy way to prevent crashes to overload some ones system is to implement a general limit setting on how much a system can do draw calls for example.
ok that is a wall of text. I'm really sorry. but I just wanted to get some things out of my system. hope at least smth might be considered worth thinking about it. 
but untill then Im likely not gonna be playing vrchat anymore since this update is deal breaking in my opinion. maybe Im being dramatic and not ready for that change but I hope it's also understandable where I'm coming from
sincerely Crimson ^^
